_comment: Trainer battle lines. '|' starts a new text box paragraph; lines are word-wrapped automatically. Straight apostrophes are converted to the game's ’ glyph. Each trainer gets lines from the pools, picked deterministically from its index.

TRMSG_INTRO: Aye! You lookin' at me? Nah, you was DEFINITELY lookin' at me.
This my block. You ain't from around here, huh?
Run your pockets! ...Or we can battle, I guess.
My homies been waitin' all day for somebody to pull up.
You walked down the wrong street, lil bro.
I seen you on the block earlier. You lost or somethin'?
Ayo, the whole squad outside today. Pull up!
Who let YOU out the house?
My crew is undefeated! ...This week.
Hold up, hold up. You think you hard? Prove it.
Square up! My homies ready, I'm ready, my grandma's ready.
You stepped on my J's! Now we gotta battle.
I ain't even mad. I'm just finna take your lunch money.
Ain't no Wi-Fi out here. Only smoke.
Nah, nah. You gotta pay the toll to walk past me.
Mama said be home by the streetlights. That gives me 5 minutes to whoop you.
Bro thinks he's the main character. Let's fix that.
Tell your gang I said wassup... after I beat 'em.
My homie said you was talkin' crazy about me in the group chat.
Yo, is that a BURNER? That's cute. Let's go.
You got that new-in-town energy. I can smell it.
Ayo, you got a lighter? No? Then you got a problem.
I'm on the clock, so make this quick.
Stop right there! This a no-loitering zone. Except for me.
I been training my crew in the parking lot all summer!
It's always the quiet ones... Let's get it!
My landlord got a “Love Is Love” sign AND raised my rent 40%. Battle me!
Ayo, you vote? Me neither. Let's fight about it anyway!
My cousin say the government put chips in the Hood Balls. Prove him wrong!
I'm a socialist. Your homies belong to ME now!
Bro, I listen to political podcasts. I'm basically a genius. Square up!
This block is a safe space. For ME. Not you.
Boutta snatch that chain off you broke boy!
Aye boy I run this block! Check it
TRMSG_LOSE: Bruh... that's crazy.
Okay, okay. I was lettin' you win.
Nah, my controller was off.
My homies is cooked...
I'm tellin' my cousin about you.
Aight, you got that. ONE time.
Man, I'm finna move to the suburbs.
Ain't no way. AIN'T NO WAY.
Respect. ...Don't tell nobody.
I gotta go home and rethink my life.
Bro really came in here and did that.
That's cap! ...No, that was real.
My whole crew just got sent to the shadow realm.
This why I don't leave the porch.
Lag! That was lag!
Not in front of the whole block, man...
I'll be back. My uncle know people.
You fight like my grandma. That's a compliment.
Yeah, yeah, take your little win and go.
TS PMO
TRMSG_AFTER: Don't come back around here. ...Unless you got snacks.
You alright, I guess. For a nobody.
Word on the street is the Block Boss up ahead don't play.
I'm just out here tryna get my bread up, man.
Next time I'm bringin' my cousin. He got a CHOPPA.
You keep a Burner on you? Smart. Real smart.
If your homies is hurt, hit up the Trap House. They patch you up free.
I ain't mad. I'm just disappointed in my crew.
Don't tell my mama I lost.
Real recognize real. Go 'head and pass.
Ayo, you ever been to Goldenrod? That's where the real ones at.
My homie said Hot Chips heal you better than Band-Aids.
You got hands, I'll give you that.
Stay dangerous out here, lil bro.
I'm still the king of this corner. Spiritually.
Keep it movin'. I got a reputation to rebuild.
I swear my crew is better on Tuesdays.
Politicians been promisin' this block a park since '04. Still waitin'.
My uncle voted for both parties in the same election. Respect.
The mayor came through once. For a photo. Then he dipped.
My liberal arts degree said I'd be a winner. Lies.
Taxes took half my bread and the pothole still there.
TRMSG_PHONE_REMATCH_INTRO: You thought I forgot? I been waitin' by the phone!
I been practicing! Me and the homies hit the gym!
TRMSG_WIN: Haha! Go home and tell your mama!
That's what I thought. Stay off my block!
TRMSG_LAST_POKE: It's just me and my last homie now. We ride together!
Last one standing. Don't count us out!
TRMSG_LAST_POKE_HALF: Nah, you good! Walk it off!
TRMSG_DBL_INTRO_1: Me and my twin run this block!
TRMSG_DBL_AFTER_1: We still run this block. Just... not today.
TRMSG_DBL_1POKE_1: You need at least two homies to fight us!

TRAINERCLASS_BUG_CATCHER: I'm the lookout! I see EVERYTHING! ...I didn't see you though.
I'm watchin' the block for the big homies. Five-oh or YOU, same thing.
TRAINERCLASS_YOUNGSTER: This corner is MINE. I been standin' here since 3rd grade!
My shorts are the coolest shorts on this block! Battle me!
TRAINERCLASS_HIKER: Back in MY day, we battled uphill both ways!
Youngblood! Let the Old Head teach you somethin'.
TRAINERCLASS_FISHERMAN: Shh! You're scarin' the fish. Now you gotta battle.
I been on this pier since '87. Respect the pier!
TRAINERCLASS_BIKER: VROOM VROOM! That's my mouth, the bike's in the shop.
Biker Gang don't stop for NOBODY!
TRAINERCLASS_TEAM_ROCKET: FBI! Open up! ...Wait, we're outside. FBI! Stand still!
You have the right to remain silent. Your homies do NOT.
We been tappin' your Burner for WEEKS. We heard everything.
This is a federal investigation. Hand over your homies!
I'm undercover. Act natural. ...I said ACT NATURAL!
We know about the group chat. ALL of it.
TRAINERCLASS_TEAM_ROCKET_F: Federal agent! Your crew is under arrest!
I've been undercover as a mail lady for six months. Battle me!
TRAINERCLASS_SCIENTIST_GS: I'm cookin' up somethin' special in the lab. Battle me!
TRAINERCLASS_POLICEMAN: Mall Cop! Freeze! ...Please freeze. I don't get paid enough to chase you.
TRAINERCLASS_FIREBREATHER: I like fire. A LOT. Don't ask me questions.
TRAINERCLASS_SUPER_NERD: I hacked the mainframe. Now I'ma hack YOUR crew.
TRAINERCLASS_GENTLEMAN: Your rent is LATE. We settle this the old-fashioned way.
TRAINERCLASS_BEAUTY: Ugh, you're blocking my lighting. Battle me.
TRAINERCLASS_SAGE: Wise Guy say: man who walk into tower get WRECKED.
TRAINERCLASS_SCHOOL_KID_M: I'm skippin' school today! Don't snitch!
TRAINERCLASS_SCHOOL_KID_F: Skippin' school is a vibe! Battle me!

named._comment: Exact trainer name (as in trainers.json, without {TRNAME}) -> message type -> text. Applies to every trainer with that name.

Silver.TRMSG_INTRO: You got a crew from Elm's lab too? Too bad mine's better.
Silver.TRMSG_LOSE: Tch... You only won 'cause your homies is soft.
Silver.TRMSG_WIN: Hmph. Just like I thought. You're nobody.
Silver.TRMSG_LAST_POKE: I don't need a whole gang. I can do this by myself!
Silver.TRMSG_LAST_POKE_HALF: Get up! I didn't steal you from a lab to lose!
Silver.TRMSG_AFTER: I'ma be the biggest kingpin in the world. Watch.

Falkner.TRMSG_LAST_POKE: The pigeons stay with me till the end!
Falkner.TRMSG_LOSE: My pops ran this block with pigeons... and I lost it.

Bugsy.TRMSG_LAST_POKE: One lookout left! He sees EVERYTHING!
Bugsy.TRMSG_LOSE: Man... I'm too young for this.

Whitney.TRMSG_LAST_POKE: My MILTANK is undefeated! Don't you DARE!
Whitney.TRMSG_LAST_POKE_HALF: Stay UP! I'll cry, I swear!
Whitney.TRMSG_LOSE: Waaaah! You BULLY! I'm tellin' EVERYBODY!

Morty.TRMSG_LAST_POKE: You can't fight what you can't see...

Chuck.TRMSG_LAST_POKE: WAHAHAHA! One more! I can do push-ups between rounds!
Chuck.TRMSG_LAST_POKE_HALF: PAIN IS JUST WEAKNESS LEAVING THE BODY!
Chuck.TRMSG_LOSE: ...My wife is gonna clown me so hard.

Jasmine.TRMSG_LAST_POKE: Um... my last homie is made of steel. Sorry.

Pryce.TRMSG_LAST_POKE: I've been ice cold since before your parents was born.
Pryce.TRMSG_LOSE: Hmph. The young blood got heat.

Clair.TRMSG_LAST_POKE: I'm the Drama Queen! I NEVER lose!
Clair.TRMSG_LOSE: This is NOT happening right now!

Lance.TRMSG_LAST_POKE: My DRAGONITE has never been beaten. Never.
Lance.TRMSG_LAST_POKE_HALF: Is this... fear? Nah. Couldn't be.
Lance.TRMSG_LOSE: ...It's over. You're the new Kingpin of Johto.

TRAINERCLASS_TEAM_ROCKET: This is goin' in my report.
TRAINERCLASS_TEAM_ROCKET_F: My supervisor is gonna kill me.
You'll be hearing from our lawyers.

TRAINERCLASS_TEAM_ROCKET: The Feds always win in the end. Usually. Sometimes.
Just so you know, we got a van parked outside your mama's house.
Don't look at the white van. There is no white van.
TRAINERCLASS_TEAM_ROCKET_F: We'll be watching you. Literally. Through your phone.
